name: Stamina Necromancer Flexible PvE
author: DeadxxSmile / ATTB Community Launch Bundle
summary: Pure-class corpse engine using Grave Lord’s Sacrifice, Detonating Siphon, Avid Boneyard, and Corpseburster-style progression.

concepts.title: Primary resource
concepts.text: Put normal attribute points into Stamina. Magicka remains available for armor and support skills.

concepts.title: Corpses are a resource
concepts.text: Several abilities need a corpse. Summons, defeated enemies, and Grave Lord’s Sacrifice feed the loop.

concepts.title: Priority rotation
concepts.text: Necromancer is less about a rigid script and more about keeping summons and ground effects active, then consuming corpses efficiently.

concepts.title: Solo safety
concepts.text: Summoner’s Armor and Spirit Guardian lower incoming pressure while Venom Skull fills empty globals.

tips: Keep one skill from each native Necromancer line on the active bar whenever XP lands until all three reach rank 50.
Join Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, and Undaunted early; train mount Speed every day.
Unlock all three armor lines by equipping three pieces of each weight once, then return to the build’s leveling mix.
Do not buy Destruction Staff Tri Focus for this setup; it can change blocking behavior with an Ice Staff and is not needed here.
Ring of the Pale Order blocks outside healing. Remove it when a duo partner or group healer needs to heal you.
The two listed Class Mastery choices require all three native class lines at rank 50. Subclassing disables Class Mastery.
Scribing abilities are optional progression gates. Use the named temporary class or weapon skill until the Grimoire and scripts are unlocked.
Detonating Siphon cannot start without a corpse. Do not treat an empty cast as a bug.
Refresh Skeletal Archer and Spirit Guardian before they expire when you need predictable corpse timing.

In the solo/duo baseline, Pestilent Colossus is primarily front-barred for Grave Lord/Corpseburster synergy; Shooting Star is the normal cast ultimate. Cast Colossus in groups when Major Vulnerability is actually needed.
Sul-Xan is strongest with reliable add deaths; Whorl is the dependable no-add/boss alternative. Pale Order is a solo mythic and should come off when outside healing matters.
ATTB only treats Medicinal Use as a combat-required crafting passive. Spend the rest of your crafting skill points according to the professions you actually want to develop.

variants.name: Flexible PvE (base)
variants.summary: Uses the general-purpose base build for solo and group PvE.

class.summary: This build keeps all three native Necromancer skill lines for pure-class progression and Class Mastery access.

race.summary: Race changes damage, sustain, and utility slightly, but ordinary PvE content does not require the recommended option.
notes: Record the race you actually chose; ATTB keeps it separate from the build recommendation.

alliance.summary: Alliance primarily determines PvP faction and some story context. It does not change this PvE combat setup.
notes: Any Race, Any Alliance and Alliance Change Tokens can make race and alliance independent.

mundus.summary: The Thief increases Critical Chance and is the default damage Mundus for this launch build.
notes: Activate a different Mundus stone at any time to replace the current blessing.

front_weapon.summary: The front bar holds the main spammable, class burst, and offensive passives.

back_weapon.summary: The second weapon bar unlocks at character level 15 and normally carries longer-duration effects and support skills.

leveling_armor.summary: Mixed armor weights level multiple armor skill lines while Training traits accelerate experience gain.

endgame_armor.summary: The final weight mix balances damage passives, penetration, sustain, and Undaunted Mettle.

leveling_trait.summary: Training increases experience gained from kills. Replace leveling pieces freely rather than upgrading them heavily.

gear_cap.summary: Equipment stops scaling at Level 50 / CP160, so that is the first point where farming and upgrading permanent sets makes sense.

format_notes: Schema 4: flexible PvE progression, explicit hotbars and ultimates, complete loadouts, structured rotations, individual equipment slots, and acquisition-aware set groups.
Schema 4 supports metadata, class-line configurations, Scribing recipes, multiple loadouts, variants, quickslots, transformations, companions, performance notes, and namespaced extensions.

notes: Class Mastery requires all three native class skill lines at rank 50 and is unavailable while foreign class lines are active.
Pure-class starting configuration. Schema 4 can replace up to two lines with mastered or actively subclassed foreign class lines.
